fixtures.description: Negative case: private resources fail closed if package verification fails, authority is invalid, or unauthenticated requests are received.
Negative case: an expired, stale, or replayed backup revision cannot replace the last valid accepted authority; restoring older state after newer data is accepted is detected and rejected.
Negative case: one modified byte in any release artifact (engine binary, web asset, rego rules, or manifest) must not produce trusted success and fails closed.
Negative case: wrong signer, rogue key ID, or invalid signature fails closed and cannot produce trusted success.

Data-safe install and upgrade specification: verifies clean installation, acceptance of initial data R1, in-place forward upgrade preserving all accepted state in .local-data/ without loss, and subsequent acceptance of newer data R2.
Cryptographically signed release verification specification: verifies release authenticity against independently trusted Ed25519 identity key, SHA-256 checksums, and artifact integrity.
Documented source-build alternative specification: confirms independent local source compilation produces functionally equivalent artifacts compatible with existing local storage.
